verdicts.reason: A: the headline is strong and the hierarchy reads well left to right. Its flaws are the body copy, squeezed into a narrow five-line ragged column, and the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge, which is oversized and competes with the CTA. B: a particle dot cuts into the logo so it reads 'SOLST CE', and the badge is jammed against the top edge. B's headline is also undersized, its body copy wraps to an orphaned 'golden hour.', and a large dead gap sits between the can and the text block.
